"""Minimal PocketCoffea dimuon workflow: select good muons and count them per event."""

import awkward as ak

from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessorABC
from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator


class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessorABC):
    def __init__(self, cfg: Configurator):
        super().__init__(cfg)

    def apply_object_preselection(self, variation):
        muons = self.events.Muon
        muon_mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        self.events["MuonGood"] = muons[muon_mask]

    def count_objects(self, variation):
        self.events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood, axis=1)
